focus-ring.comment: The focus indicator colour. Lives in tier-3 because it is a THEME-level alias of a tier-2 semantic, exactly like header/body background. Before this existed, `al-focus()` read `var(--al-theme-color-focus-ring, var(--al-theme-color-border-primary-default))` against a token the pipeline never emitted, so the fallback always won and no brand or mode could restate the focus colour without editing the mixin.
